meta.name: Badlands
meta.description: Rolling hills studded with stone arches, overhanging ledges, outcrops jutting from the slopes and boulders. Arches and ledges often stand over a tank's spawn, so it starts with a roof over its head. Gunpowder seams run under the slopes and a magma pocket or two lies deep down. About two maps in three also get one big landform: a deep valley, twin peaks, a flat open plain, a cliff wall or a mesa.
